decisions.reason: As a core hearty bread loaf with no negative signals, the option remains cheap to keep open while its established demand continues.
The sweet pastry fits the firm's traditional assortment and shows no negative results, so the option is worth keeping while market acceptance remains favorable.
The crusty farmhouse bread is a newer bread option that still fits the core portfolio, but its shorter track record and overlap with another bread create a somewhat higher chance of dropping.
The poppy seed Christmas stollen is presented as a flagship and has a gold award, which resolves enough uncertainty to justify continued commitment and a very low drop probability.
The premium Christmas stollen also has a gold award, but as a second stollen option it is slightly less protected and could be dropped if resources shift to the flagship.
